solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: African doctor is able to accommodate gigantic bird

indicators.note: to accommodate is to take in and house, so one piece goes inside another

blocks.note: MO is a medical officer, a doctor
the roc is the huge bird of Arabian legend
can means is able

explanation.surface: An African physician manages to house an enormous bird.
explanation.walkthrough: MO is followed by CAN, and CAN takes in the legendary roc: MO + ROC + CAN.
explanation.definitionFit: A Moroccan is a native of Morocco, a country in North Africa, so the word works as an adjective or noun meaning African.

clue.text: Chap carrying leftover food up for head nurse

indicators.note: up in a down clue means the word reads from bottom to top
carrying means holding the other letters within

blocks.note: a chap is a man
an ort is a scrap of food left after a meal

explanation.surface: A man carries leftover food upstairs for the senior nurse.
explanation.walkthrough: ORT is a crossword favourite for a scrap of leftover food.
explanation.definitionFit: A matron is the senior nursing officer in charge of a hospital's nurses.

clue.text: Parliamentarian leader holding up circular

blocks.note: round means circular
a head is a leader

explanation.surface: A political leader is endorsing a circular letter.
explanation.walkthrough: In a down clue, the leader holding up the circular sits beneath it. Roundheads were Parliament's supporters in the English Civil War.
explanation.definitionFit: Roundheads fought for Parliament against the Royalists in the English Civil War, so a Roundhead was a Parliamentarian.

clue.text: Discharge sailor picked up by vehicle at hospital

indicators.note: picked up by means collected inside a vehicle, so one word goes in another

blocks.note: a car is a vehicle
a tar is a sailor
H is the map sign for hospital

explanation.surface: A sailor is discharged and collected by car at the hospital.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Picked up' tempts as a homophone signal, but here the sailor rides inside the car.
explanation.definitionFit: Catarrh is a build-up of mucus in the nose and throat, a bodily discharge.

clue.text: Extreme suffering of some collecting game

indicators.note: collecting means gathering in, so the first word holds the second

blocks.note: any as in some
Go is the Japanese board game

explanation.surface: Some collectors of game birds suffer terribly.
explanation.definitionFit: Agony is intense physical or mental pain, which is extreme suffering.

clue.text: Item left in car with sloping roof

indicators.note: in places one letter inside the car word that follows

blocks.note: a coupé is a car with a sloping rear roofline
L is the standard abbreviation for left

explanation.surface: Something has been left behind in a fastback car.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Item' here is the noun for a romantic pair, as in 'they are an item'.
explanation.definitionFit: Two people in a relationship are called an item, which is a synonym for a couple.

clue.text: Substance producing rust in west, reportedly

indicators.note: reportedly means as heard said, so the answer is sounded out

blocks.note: the Occident is the West

explanation.surface: A rust-causing chemical in the western world, according to reports.
explanation.walkthrough: The homophone is approximate: the West is the Occident, said close to the chemistry word.
explanation.definitionFit: An oxidant is an oxidising agent, and oxidation of iron is what forms rust.

clue.text: Art work created by two characters in Thessaloniki

blocks.note: pi is a Greek letter; Thessaloniki is a Greek city
eta is another Greek letter

explanation.surface: A work of art made by two people in a Greek city.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Characters' are letters, and Thessaloniki points to the Greek alphabet.
explanation.definitionFit: A pietà is a painting or sculpture of the Virgin Mary holding the dead Christ, a famous type of art work.

clue.text: Writer for example visiting little sibling in film

indicators.note: visiting means going inside, so the example word sits within the sibling
in places the combined letters inside the film title

blocks.note: E.T. is the Spielberg film
sis is short for sister
say means for example

explanation.surface: A writer, for instance, visits a small sister on a film set.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Little' shortens sister to SIS rather than describing a younger sibling.
explanation.definitionFit: An essayist writes essays, so is a kind of writer.

clue.text: Go to seed, having originally served this old family member

indicators.note: originally means at the start, so only the opening letters are used

blocks.note: first letters of served and this
an agnate is a relative on the father's side, an old-fashioned term

explanation.surface: A former relative goes to seed after first serving.
explanation.walkthrough: AGNATE is a dated word for a relation through the male line.
explanation.definitionFit: To go to seed is to decline from inactivity, and to stagnate is to stop developing.

clue.text: Reliability of management line about spare points

indicators.note: about means turned round, so the word for line is read from the end back

blocks.note: a trust is a body that manages property or funds on others' behalf
a row is a line
spare in the sense of lean, thin
compass points East, South, South

explanation.surface: An inquiry into whether a firm's management line on spare points can be relied upon.
explanation.walkthrough: Points are compass points, a crossword staple for E, N, S and W.
explanation.definitionFit: Trustworthiness is the quality of being dependable, a direct synonym of reliability.

clue.text: Methodical male hospital attendant …

blocks.note: first meaning: neat and well arranged
second meaning: a hospital worker doing non-medical tasks

explanation.walkthrough: The ellipsis runs the clue into the next one, but this clue stands on its own.
explanation.definitionFit: The adjective means arranged in good order, and the noun names an attendant who carries out routine tasks in a hospital.

clue.text: … dashed into Cooper's Farm Feed Store?

indicators.note: into says the word for dashed goes inside the actor's name

blocks.note: Gary Cooper, the Hollywood film star
dashed means ran

explanation.surface: Continuing the previous clue, the orderly rushed into Cooper's farm shop.
explanation.walkthrough: Cooper's looks like a farm's name, but it signals the first name of Gary Cooper; the question mark marks the definition as loose.
explanation.definitionFit: A granary is a storehouse for threshed grain, which is a farm's feed for animals.

clue.text: Chapel keys regularly kept by woman attorney

indicators.note: regularly means taking every other letter of the word before it
kept by means held inside the following words

blocks.note: Beth is a woman's name
second and fourth letters of keys
DA is a District Attorney in the US

explanation.surface: Keys to a chapel are routinely held by a female lawyer.
explanation.walkthrough: Bethesda is a common name for Welsh Nonconformist chapels, taken from the healing pool in the Gospel of John.
explanation.definitionFit: Bethesda is a name given to many Nonconformist places of worship, so it stands as an example of a chapel.

clue.text: Furtive way with money? Not wife!

indicators.note: not wife says the letter for wife is taken out

blocks.note: St is the abbreviation for street, a way
wealthy means having money
W is the abbreviation for wife

explanation.surface: A sly way to come into money is to be rid of one's wife.
explanation.definitionFit: Stealthy means acting quietly and secretly to avoid notice, which is close to furtive.

clue.text: Nice time for casual workers!

blocks.note: first meaning: the French word for time, as used in Nice
second meaning: temporary staff

explanation.walkthrough: Nice is the French city, not the adjective, so 'Nice time' asks for the French word.
explanation.definitionFit: Temps is French for time, and in English the plural noun means temporary office staff hired short term.

clue.text: Piece of silicon Greek character found in farmer's yield by motorway

indicators.note: found in means located inside the farm word

blocks.note: the M1 is Britain's main north-south motorway, written MI
a crop is what a farmer harvests
chi is a Greek letter

explanation.surface: A tech part with a Greek letter is discovered in a farm's harvest beside a motorway.
explanation.walkthrough: The M1 is a British motorway, and its 1 stands in for the letter I.
explanation.definitionFit: A microchip is a small wafer of silicon carrying an integrated circuit.

clue.text: Erudite academic, old, and German

blocks.note: prof is short for professor
O is the abbreviation for old
the German word for and

explanation.surface: An old German professor described as learned.
explanation.walkthrough: 'and, German' asks for the German word for and, not a German person.
explanation.definitionFit: Profound means showing great knowledge or insight, a near synonym of erudite.

clue.text: Gaseous element identified by academy teacher

blocks.note: RA is the Royal Academy
a don is a university teacher

explanation.surface: A gas is discovered by a science teacher at an academy.
explanation.definitionFit: Radon is a radioactive noble gas, element number 86 on the periodic table.

clue.text: Unpretentious character on the staff

blocks.note: first meaning: unaffected, without airs
second meaning: a musical sign cancelling a sharp or flat

explanation.walkthrough: The staff is the five-line stave of written music, not a team of employees.
explanation.definitionFit: The word means relaxed and unaffected, and in music it names the sign that restores a note to its plain pitch.

clue.text: Polish member enters spiritualist meeting, missing start

indicators.note: missing start says the opening letter of the meeting word is dropped
enters means goes inside the other word

blocks.note: a séance is a meeting to contact spirits
a leg is a limb, a member of the body

explanation.surface: A Polish member of a group arrives at a séance, but late.
explanation.walkthrough: Polish looks like the nationality; it is the noun for refinement.
explanation.definitionFit: Polish in the sense of refined style and grace is a synonym for elegance.

clue.text: Make a fuss, getting it set in stone

indicators.note: set in means mounted inside, as a gem in a setting

blocks.note: agate is a semi-precious stone
taken as written

explanation.surface: Someone protests about having something carved in stone.
explanation.definitionFit: To agitate is to campaign or stir things up, which is to make a fuss.

clue.text: Shearwater, say, found by domestic animal on lake

blocks.note: a pet is a domestic animal
re means on or concerning
L is the abbreviation for lake

explanation.surface: A seabird is discovered by a household pet beside a lake.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Say' marks the shearwater as an example of the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: Shearwaters are seabirds of the petrel family, so a shearwater is one example of a petrel.

clue.text: Right inside baptismal bowl, a large hanging drapery

indicators.note: inside says the letter for right goes within the bowl word

blocks.note: a font holds the water for baptism
R is the abbreviation for right
taken as written
L is the clothing-size abbreviation for large

explanation.surface: A large cloth hangs in a church near the font.
explanation.walkthrough: A frontal is an altar cloth, so the church picture holds both halves.
explanation.definitionFit: A frontal is a decorative cloth hung over the front of an altar, a piece of hanging drapery.

clue.text: Mature person shaving member of fighting force?

indicators.note: shaving means trimming off the edges, so both end letters go

blocks.note: a soldier belongs to an army

explanation.surface: Can a grown man shaving be a soldier?
explanation.definitionFit: An oldie is an informal word for an older person, someone mature in years.

clue.text: Part of plant greeting Zulu in European capital

indicators.note: in places the greeting and letter inside the city name

blocks.note: Rome is the capital of Italy
hi is a greeting
Zulu is the NATO alphabet word for Z

explanation.surface: Part of a tourist's trip: greeting a Zulu visitor in a European capital.
explanation.definitionFit: A rhizome is an underground stem that sends out roots and shoots, so it is a part of a plant.

clue.text: Horse, possibly, nibbling root of willow tree

indicators.note: the root of a word is its base, taken here as its first letter
nibbling means taking into the mouth, so the horse holds the letter

blocks.note: a roan is a horse with a mixed coat; possibly because roan is also a colour
first letter of willow

explanation.surface: A horse nibbles at the roots of a willow tree.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Willow tree' reads as one phrase, but willow belongs to the wordplay and tree alone is the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: The rowan, or mountain ash, is a small tree with red berries.

clue.text: After university we'd threaten her appallingly? That's a bit sick!

indicators.note: appallingly means very badly, so the preceding words are badly jumbled

blocks.note: U is the abbreviation for university
these letters rearranged

explanation.surface: After college, a nasty threat against a woman is condemned as rather sick.
explanation.walkthrough: 'After university' puts U at the front, not after the rest; the question mark admits the surface is odd.
explanation.definitionFit: Being under the weather is an idiom for feeling slightly unwell.

clue.text: Travel on river — seriously

blocks.note: the Dee is a river in Britain
to ply is to travel a route regularly

explanation.surface: Someone sails on a river with grave intent.
explanation.walkthrough: In an across clue 'on' means after, so the travel word follows the river.
explanation.definitionFit: Deeply in the sense of profoundly or gravely is a synonym of seriously, as in deeply hurt.

clue.text: Not having worried, put in for global police force

indicators.note: not having says the word for worried is removed from the next word

blocks.note: to interpolate is to insert something
ate as in ate at, worried or troubled

explanation.surface: Instructions to insert something calmly, without worry, for the world's police.
explanation.walkthrough: 'What's eating you?' shows ate meaning worried; it comes off the end of interpolate.
explanation.definitionFit: Interpol is the International Criminal Police Organization, which coordinates policing worldwide.
